messages:
sre-lead: FYI team: we're running a synthetic loadtest + SLO recalibration in us-east on 2026-04-20 02:00 UTC (overnight) to validate our 99.9% p95 SLA under bursty patterns. This is a non-destructive test but expect short 5xx blips and elevated latency while autoscaling stabilizes. Total window 90m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/synthetic-loadtest.
ops_pm: ack. I'll coordinate with Growth to pause scheduled demos in that window.
kevin: I'll kick off the load generator and own traffic shaping. Plan: ramp 0%->20%->60%->100% over 30m, hold 30m, then ramp down 10m. Observability owners: please ensure sampling bumped for traces.
oncall-bot: Reminder: PagerDuty slips to @oncall for the period (policy: loadtest). Automated alert suppression will be applied to avoid operator noise.
cs-lead: CS: noted. I'll prep a short note for customers on Dedicated plans and flag enterprise accounts with live sessions.
platform-eng: Important: two jobs ( nightly-index and realtime-export ) should be paused 15m before start. I'll add a flag to the job-scheduler repo.
infra-bot: Heads-up: there's a concurrent network maintenance in the same region scheduled 02:15 UTC (ASN refresh). If this conflicts, reply `hold-net` within 1h.
sre-lead: good catch infra-bot 15m buffer preferred -> infra-bot please reschedule to 03:00 UTC.
kevin: health checks I'll use during ramp: `curl -fsS -H \"X-Test: loadtest\" https://internal-status/api/v1/health` and `promql: sum(rate(http_request_errors[5m])) by (route)`. Abort criteria: sustained error-rate > 1.5% for 10m OR p99 latency > 3x baseline for 5m.
ops_pm: I added the post-test survey and will collect perf traces + any customer-facing incidents.
cs-lead: prepared canned support text and escalation contacts.
platform-eng: job flags applied and PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/256. Will revert after the window.
oncall-bot: Channel created: #incidents/loadtest-1777023456. Alerts will post there.
sre-lead: Thanks all. Please ack ASAP if your team cannot comply or has live traffic concerns. I'll publish the postmortem template here after the test. /end
